Title: [JOURNEY] Thumbnails — regenerate one product image folder, storefront loads the new _md/_sm
Preconditions:
Image Tools (SkiaSharp build, VirtoCommerce.ImageTools 3.1007.0 or later) and Assets modules installed on {{BACK_URL}}; admin credentials {{ADMIN_EMAIL}} / {{ADMIN_PASSWORD}} sign in
Setting ImageTools.Thumbnails.AllowedImageFormats is at its default (AllowedValues JPEG, PNG, Webp, SVG, no override)
The case owns its data: assets folder AGENT-TEST-6268-<run>, its options and its task are created by the case and deleted in Cleanup; no existing catalog task is run
{{FRONT_URL}} accessible with a catalog listing that shows product cards (read-only use, no storefront data is changed)
Steps:
--- SCREEN: Admin REST - build and run the thumbnail task ---
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, admin {{ADMIN_EMAIL}} / {{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}); keep the Bearer token for every call below
[SETUP] <run> = current UTC yyyyMMddHHmmss; F = AGENT-TEST-6268-<run> (own assets folder, unique prefix so no other task can cover it)
[SETUP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/assets?folderUrl=F as multipart field 'file' = bytes of @td(IMG_THUMB_QUADRANT_JPEG.path), uploaded under the file name 'quadrant-301x199.jpeg' (bytes unchanged, renamed to .jpeg so the case does not depend on the .jpg gate, which IMGTL-031 owns); expect 200 (the upload creates F)
[SETUP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/image/thumbnails/options body {"name":"AGENT-TEST-6268-<run>-md6268","fileSuffix":"md6268","resizeMethod":"FixedWidth","width":275,"jpegQuality":"High"}; expect 200; keep the returned option (id and fields)
[SETUP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/image/thumbnails/options body {"name":"AGENT-TEST-6268-<run>-sm6268","fileSuffix":"sm6268","resizeMethod":"FixedWidth","width":100,"jpegQuality":"High"}; expect 200; keep the returned option (id and fields)
[SETUP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/image/thumbnails/tasks body {"name":"AGENT-TEST-6268-<run>","workPath":"F","thumbnailOptions":[<md option>,<sm option>]} (option objects as returned above); expect 200; keep the task id. Created AFTER the uploads so the upload event does not start a job
[CAPTURE] record the UTC time the run is started
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/image/thumbnails/tasks/run body {"taskIds":["<taskId>"],"regenerate":true}; expect 200; keep the notification id and jobId from the response
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/pushnotifications body {"ids":["<notification id>"],"take":1} every 3 s, up to 120 s, until notifyEvents[0].finished is set (totalCount/processedCount stay 0/0 on this build, so never wait on or assert counts)
--- SCREEN: Assets - what the storefront will request ---
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/assets?folderUrl=F; keep the names and sizes of every entry (the blob listing is the source of truth for what was generated)
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/cms-content/assets/F/quadrant-301x199_md6268.jpeg (Bearer token); expect 200; keep the bytes, Content-Type and Last-Modified
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/cms-content/assets/F/quadrant-301x199_sm6268.jpeg (Bearer token); expect 200; keep the bytes, Content-Type and Last-Modified
[CAPTURE] decode the downloaded bytes with an image decoder in the runner script and record format signature, width, height and the RGBA of the listed pixels
--- SCREEN: Storefront - the consumer of _md/_sm ---
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/catalog
[WAIT] category grid loaded
[ACT] open the first category that lists product cards
[WAIT] product cards with images are loaded
[CAPTURE] browser network requests for product card images: URL, status and Content-Type of every request whose file name ends _md or _sm before the extension (vc-image falls back to the original on error, so the requested URL and its status are the observable, never the rendered picture)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] every REST call in the flow returned 2xx
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on the storefront image requests
[CONSOLE] no JS error on the storefront page
Failure_Signals: Original returned instead of _md/_sm; 0-byte or undecodable thumbnail; Last-Modified older than the run start; _md/_sm card requests 404; run never finishes within 120 s
Cleanup:
DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/image/thumbnails/tasks?ids=<taskId>; DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/image/thumbnails/options?ids=<optionId> (one ids= per option created by this case); DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/assets?urls=F
Storefront side: nothing to clean (read-only); close the browser page
Run the cleanup even when a step failed; afterwards GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/assets?folderUrl=F lists no entries and the tasks/options search shows no AGENT-TEST-6268-<run> entry
